speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Workmen, still, in a wood. I am reading it to the fire and not to a press. If I wanted it set I would have left it, and I am not leaving it.

speaker: richard_field
text: Sea-coal, and a man reading. I can bear both. I cannot bear a promise of a book, so do not make me one while the bar is cold. The bar is cold. It can stay cold.

speaker: jacqueline_field
text: The cups stay where they are until you are actually gone. I said I would wash them. I did not say I would wash them as an excuse to hear the plot again.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then hear the fire. I am at the place where she sees him, and I am stopping where I stopped this morning.
